environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed on a bare-metal Ubuntu 22.04 server running PHP-FPM 8.2 as www-data user. The storage/app/exports directory is on the same ext4 filesystem as the rest of the system. No filesystem-level restrictions on symlink creation or following. The application uses a standard PostgreSQL 15 connection with a single database user that has full SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on all tables. Tenant isolation is enforced only at the application layer via the WHERE tenant_id clause in queries. The www-data user has read access to /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow (group shadow), and other tenant export directories.
